scope: Appendix A: Merits and Flaws; complete edition-specific audit against the English text copy and project source extract.

printed_page_map.Supernatural Merits and Flaws: 425–429 (merits p.425–426; flaws p.426–428; Road Aura table p.428–429)

limitations: The accessible book text is a third-party text reproduction; the publisher-issued book is official, but no publisher PDF raster pages were available for image-by-image verification in this session.
Printed section/page references were checked against the book contents listing and embedded page markers; individual line placement on page images was not independently inspected.
The source Markdown extract is a project-side Russian translation/summary, not an official Russian translation; translated titles are not represented as official localized names.
The two Road Aura traits each produce two separate database records (Merit and Flaw) according to Road rating, explaining 86 records for 84 distinct names.

Clan Apostate and Permanent Third Eye are categorized as clan-specific under KAMEN policy despite their placement in the book’s supernatural section; one prior Clan Apostate record was reused, not duplicated.
